data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure's order (World Bank, then Wikipedia, then compose To/Subject/Body, then discard), but it lists GDP, growth, population, capital and currency as input parameters when they are values read from the pages, it leaves out the client-to-email mapping (client@example.com and "Hi {client}"), and it gives no exact body template, tab switching or search mechanics, so an automation built from it would have to guess.
